description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center. This confidential opportunity is ideal for a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the facility's continued success and positive impact on the community.

As the LNHA, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, including clinical services, financial performance, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This role offers a chance to make a significant difference in the lives of residents and staff, fostering a supportive and high-quality care environment. We offer a competitive salary for this critical leadership position.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations, financial performance, and staff development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
Join a premier medical facility in NYC, NY, seeking a highly skilled Orthopedic Surgeon. This full-time role offers a competitive compensation package, with a base salary ranging from $300,000 to $350,000 per year, significantly supplemented by substantial bonus opportunities. We are looking for a dedicated professional to contribute to our patient-centered care environment.

As an Orthopedic Surgeon, you will be responsible for diagnosing and treating musculoskeletal diseases and injuries. This is an urgent opportunity for a candidate who thrives in a dynamic setting and is committed to delivering exceptional surgical outcomes and patient satisfaction.

We value experience and expertise, particularly in handling complex cases involving workers' compensation and no-fault claims. If you are a seasoned Orthopedic Surgeon looking for a rewarding position with substantial earning potential, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD/DO) degree from an accredited institution
Board Certification or Eligibility in Orthopedic Surgery
Current, unrestricted New York State medical license
Minimum of 5 years of post-residency experience as an Orthopedic Surgeon
Demonstrated experience with Workers' Compensation and No-Fault cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $300,000 - $350,000 per year, with a heavy emphasis on bonuses over base salary.
